<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

use PhotoCompetitionManager\Repository\Competitions_Repository;
use PhotoCompetitionManager\Repository\Members_Repository;
use PhotoCompetitionManager\Support\Competition_Settings;

foreach ( array(
	'Upload'  => '[competition_upload]',
	'Voting'  => '[competition_voting]',
	'Results' => '[competition_results]',
) as $page_title => $shortcode ) {
	wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => $page_title, 'post_content' => $shortcode ) );
}

$members = new Members_Repository();
foreach ( array(
	array( 'Ann Beginner', 'ann@example.com', 'beginner' ),
	array( 'Bob Intermediate', 'bob@example.com', 'intermediate' ),
	array( 'Cat Advanced', 'cat@example.com', 'advanced' ),
) as $m ) {
	$members->create( array( 'name' => $m[0], 'email' => $m[1], 'grade' => $m[2] ) );
}

$data = array(
	'title'      => 'Test competition',
	'slug'       => 'test-competition',
	'open_date'  => wp_date( 'Y-m-d' ),
	'close_date' => wp_date( 'Y-m-d', time() + 7 * DAY_IN_SECONDS ),
	'share_hash' => Competition_Settings::generate_share_hash(),
);

$types_class = 'PhotoCompetitionManager\Repository\Competition_Types_Repository';
if ( class_exists( $types_class ) ) {
	$types            = new $types_class();
	$type             = $types->only() ?? $types->all()[0];
	$data['type_id']  = (int) $type->id;
	$data['settings'] = Competition_Settings::settings_for_new_competition( $type );
} else {
	$data['settings'] = array_merge(
		array_diff_key( Competition_Settings::global_settings(), array( 'grades' => true ) ),
		array( 'categories' => Competition_Settings::club_categories() )
	);
}

$result = ( new Competitions_Repository() )->create( $data );
if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
	error_log( 'Playground seed: ' . $result->get_error_message() );
}
